summary: Verification code (OTP, PIN) split into one field per character. The value stays contiguous: typing advances, Backspace goes back, and paste and “one-time-code” autofill fill all positions.
whenToUse: Short fixed-length codes received via SMS, email or an authenticator app.
whenNotToUse: Passwords or variable-length codes: use PasswordInput or TextField.
Long codes (more than 8 characters): a single field is easier to correct.

props.name: label / description / errorMessage
props.description: Field parts, linked to the group and to each cell.

props.name: name
props.description: Hidden input holding the value for native form submission.

props.name: autoFocus
props.description: Focuses the first empty position on mount.

inherits: HTML attributes of the container (className, style, data-*, aria-label…); ref on the role="group" container.

keyboard.action: Enters a character and moves to the next position.
Deletes; on an empty cell, deletes the previous one and moves focus there.
Previous / next cell (up to the first empty one).
Paste: filters out disallowed characters and fills the positions.

accessibility: role="group" with the field label; each cell is named “Carattere n di N” (messages.pinDigit).
The first cell declares autocomplete="one-time-code" for operating system autofill.
Focus cannot skip past the first empty cell: the value always stays contiguous.
Error and description are linked via aria-describedby; aria-invalid on every cell.
responsive: Cells stay on one row and shrink on narrow viewports (minimum 2rem each).
On touch devices the numeric keypad appears thanks to inputMode.
customization: Selectors [data-size]; cells reuse the field tokens (border, focus, invalid).
commonMistakes: Verifying the code only on the client: verification must happen on the server, with attempt limits.
Submitting the form automatically in onComplete without an alternative confirm action for users who correct the code.
limits: Cells are always laid out left to right (dir="ltr"), even in RTL, like numeric codes.
No configurable visual separator between digit groups.
